core_equations.expression: S = int d^4x sqrt(-g) [ F R/2 - (grad phi)^2/2 - (grad chi_A)^2/2 - V ], F = xi_phi phi^2 + xi_chi X, V = (lambda_chi/4)(X - (alpha/lambda_chi) phi^2)^2 + (beta/4) phi^4, X = |chi|^2
F G_mn = T^phi_mn + T^chi_mn + (nabla_m nabla_n - g_mn box) F
box phi + xi_phi phi R - dV/dphi = 0
box chi_A + xi_chi R chi_A - 2 (dV/dX) chi_A = 0
phi E_phi + chi_A E_A + g^mn E_mn = box J / 2, J = (1 + 6 xi_phi) phi^2 + (1 + 6 xi_chi) X (off shell)

unit_system: natural units hbar = c = 1; no dimensionful parameter; <phi> sets the unit (M_Pl^2 = xi_phi <phi>^2 + xi_chi <X>)

fields_parameters.meaning: dilaton = UET response scalar Phi (psi of v1)
O(2) matter doublet (UET C in phase/charge lanes)
curvature coupling of phi; replaces 1/kappa and xi_c of v1
curvature coupling of chi (new; generated at one loop in v1, wave B1)
quartic portal phi^2 |chi|^2; replaces g_c of v1
integration constant of unimodular gravity (option b only); initial data, not a coupling

nearest_known_class.name: Higgs-dilaton model / induced gravity with a scale-invariant two-scalar potential
references: M. Shaposhnikov and D. Zenhausern, Phys. Lett. B 671, 162 (2009)

nearest_known_class.variable_map: phi = dilaton; chi_A = Higgs-like field but O(2) with 2 components instead of an SU(2) doublet

redundant_parameters.absorbed_by: canonical normalization and shift, as in v1
shift symmetry: rescales A, which Omega_DE fixes

predictions.observable: gamma_PPN - 1 = 0, no long-range fifth force, no DEF scalarisation, for every xi_phi (under the matter condition)
portal-mediated force range <= 0.21 fm (nucleon lane) or 1.6e-18 m (Higgs-like lane)
m_chi^2 / M_Pl^2 = 2 alpha / (xi_phi + xi_chi alpha / lambda_chi)
w(a): -1 under (a); under (b) exponential thawing with wa/(1 + w0) between -1.51 and -1.28, set by xi_phi alone

lane_mappings.standard_quantity: global O(2) Noether charge density N^0 (conditional)
heavy radial mode at the vacuum, candidate if layers 2-3 need a field that couples to matter

not from the action: chi = He-4 atom at tree level FAILED in T015 (2026-11-16); author decision 2026-11-16: Topic 13 Phi (He II superfluid fraction, e0 and Z_Phi by calibration) is a phenomenological closure outside the action

evidence_impact: see core/THEORY_CARD_V2_DRAFT.md section 9 and topics/0.23_Unity_Scale_Link/Doc/STRESS_14_OPEN_ITEMS_AND_CARD_V2_PHYSICS.md section 3: T001, T005, T016, T019 have no v2 counterpart; C1, C2, T040, T041 become w = -1 (a) or exponential thawing (b); layers 2-3, observation layer, Lorentz and O8 unchanged
matter_condition: every matter mass outside chi comes from phi or chi through dimensionless couplings (degree-1 function of the fields); without it the dilaton is Brans-Dicke and Cassini needs xi_phi <= 5.75e-6

gravity_options.a_ordinary: w = -1 exactly (U0 = V/F^2 at the vacuum)
gravity_options.b_unimodular: V -> V + Lambda0; Einstein-frame U = U0 + A exp(-lam sigma), lam = 4 sqrt(xi_phi / (1 + 6 xi_phi)) < 1.633; one-parameter thawing w(a) if U0 = 0

difference_note: none at the level of the action; only the chi lane (not the inflaton, so the Higgs-dilaton n_s - w0 relation and its bound xi_dilaton < 0.00328 do not bind UET) and O(2) instead of an SU(2) doublet
open_physics: quantum level: dilaton decoupling needs scale-invariant regularisation
layers 2-3 re-derived with v2 modes (dilaton friction through derivative couplings)
growth and CMB under (b), background only
no coupling value is predicted (hierarchy moved, not explained)
